description.summary: a seat of its own for a remote desktop guest

protocol.description:
A guest who works on this computer from another one, on a virtual output made for them, must not take the user's pointer or keyboard focus away. This protocol gives each guest a seat of their own, confined to the output their session shows: the pointer cannot leave it, and the keyboard focus can only go to windows on it.
A guest seat takes the same events as a crownos_input_injector_v1 and delivers them through its own wl_seat. Guest input never triggers compositor shortcuts and never reaches the lock screen.
Only the remote desktop media engine can bind the manager global.
Warning! The protocol described in this file is currently in the testing phase. Backward compatible changes may be added together with the corresponding interface version bump. Backward incompatible changes can only be done by creating a new major version of the extension.

entry.name: invalid_name
entry.summary: the name is empty, longer than 32 bytes or contains a control character

request.name: destroy
request.description: Seats created through it live on until destroyed individually.

request.name: create_seat

description.summary: create a seat confined to an output

request.description: Creates a seat for the guest called name, confined to the output whose wl_output name is output. The compositor answers with created once the seat's wl_seat global is announced, or with revoked.

arg.name: output
arg.summary: the wl_output name of the guest's output

interface.name: crownos_guest_seat_v1
interface.description:
Events are grouped into frames as on crownos_input_injector_v1: every input request adds to the pending frame and frame applies them in order. Coordinates are in the output's logical space, (0, 0) at its top-left.
Keys and buttons still pressed when the seat is destroyed or revoked are released by the compositor.

entry.name: invalid_value
entry.summary: an enum argument is out of range

entry.name: refused
entry.summary: the compositor would not create the seat

request.name: pointer_motion_absolute
request.description: Moves the pointer to (x, y) in the output's logical space.

request.name: frame
request.description: Applies the pending events in order as one logical hardware event stamped with time_ms, a CLOCK_MONOTONIC millisecond timestamp, or 0 for now.

event.name: created
event.description: The name of the wl_seat behind this guest seat.

event.name: revoked
event.description: The seat is gone and further requests are ignored. The client should destroy the object.
